name: col
description: Checks what Claude says against what actually ran: a commit it names must exist, a file it cites must be on disk, a test count must appear in real test output. Keeps a ledger of measurable predictions before long jobs and irreversible steps and compares them with the results, stops a commit or a push that would carry a key, and when a fix does not hold (the same check fails the same way after an edit) asks for rival explanations and one command that tells them apart. Local; no model calls.
